explained.?: Qt help button '?'; emtk 'Help' in the toolbar row.
explained.dwt(diffusion): Qt radio button 'DWT (Diffusion)'; emtk draws the same choice as a combo (the radio row was cut at 800 px), 'DWT (Diffusion)' is an entry of its list.
explained.isotropic: Qt radio button 'Isotropic'; emtk draws the same choice as a combo (the radio row was cut at 800 px), 'Isotropic' is an entry of its list.
explained.meanrapp/rda: Qt rich-text label 'Mean R<sub>app</sub>/R<sub>DA</sub>'; emtk table row 'Mean R_app/R_DA'.
explained.radknown(useδ): Qt rich-text label 'r<sub>AD</sub> known (use δ)'; emtk spec label 'r_AD known (use δ)' (rAD_known).
explained.rad∞: Qt rich-text label r<sub>AD∞</sub>; emtk spec label 'r_AD∞' (same field, r_ADinf).
explained.ra∞: Qt rich-text label r<sub>A∞</sub>; emtk spec label 'r_A∞' (r_Ainf).
explained.rd∞: Qt rich-text label r<sub>D∞</sub>; emtk spec label 'r_D∞' (r_Dinf).
explained.results: Qt 'Results' panel title; emtk 'Orientation statistics' window (a table of the five Qt values plus SD2 and SA2).
explained.sdrapp/rda: Qt rich-text label 'SD R<sub>app</sub>/R<sub>DA</sub>'; emtk table row 'SD R_app/R_DA'.
